title: MonsterAttackDef
description:
A monster special attack definition from JSON type `"monster_attack"`.

Defines a special attack that a monster can perform in combat, including melee strikes, grabs, ranged pulls, and EOC-triggered abilities.

blockable.description: Whether the attack can be blocked.

condition.description: Condition for the attack to be available.

damage_max_instance.description: Maximum damage instances (array of {damage_type, amount} objects).

dodgeable.description: Whether the attack can be dodged.

effects.description: Effects applied to the target on hit.

effects_require_dmg.description: Whether effects require damage to be dealt.

grab.description: Whether this attack is a grab attempt.

grab_data.description: Grab-specific data (e.g. grab effect, pull chance, pull weight ratio).

hit_dmg_npc.description: Message when the attack hits and deals damage to an NPC.

hit_dmg_u.description: Message when the attack hits and deals damage to the player.

hitsize_min.description: Minimum size of the target hit (body part size index).

miss_msg_npc.description: Message when the attack misses an NPC.

miss_msg_u.description: Message when the attack misses the player.

monster_message.description: Monster message displayed when the attack is used.

move_cost.description: Move cost to perform the attack.

no_dmg_msg_npc.description: Message when the attack hits but deals no damage to an NPC.

no_dmg_msg_u.description: Message when the attack hits but deals no damage to the player.

self_effects_always.description: Effects always applied to the attacker.

self_effects_onhit.description: Effects applied to the attacker on hit.
